ModificationScopeIndication.name: Modification Scope Indication
ModificationScopeIndication.definition: Specifies the type of modification to be applied.

CashAccountDetails.name: Cash Account Details
CashAccountDetails.definition: Account to credit or debit. When this is an account to debit, this is for the payment of a subscription to an investment fund, a savings plan payment, the purchase of securities or the payment of charges. When this is an account to credit, this is for the payment of an amount as a result of a redemption of investment fund units, the sale of securities, interest and dividend payments. A single account may be specified for all cash movements on the account or cash accounts may be specified for specific types of transactions on the account.

OtherCashSettlementDetails.name: Other Cash Settlement Details
OtherCashSettlementDetails.definition: Method of payment other than a cash account.
